messages:
Anya: dropped a tiny thread about the mini-capacity flow I sketched. goal: reorder controls so pool selection comes first, then SLO slider, then min/max & burst. mobile should be a single column but keep the cost badge pinned.
Priya: reordering makes sense. note: users often set min before picking pool which makes values invalid. forcing pool first reduces confusion.
Hugo: about `Burst` label 1
: can we change to `Temporary burst` and show duration inline (5m/30m/1h)? helps support explainers.
Marco: backend: short bursts (5m) use preemptible instances; 1h may require fallback. I'll publish allowed durations so frontend can render options.
Sam: a11y checklist: ensure pool tiles have role="button" and aria-pressed when selected. SLO slider needs aria-valuetext like "SLO 95 percent within guardrails". add aria-live polite region for cost forecast changes.
Anya: visual: cost badge should be low-contrast background with strong text; when values change animate number with cross-fade rather than rapid ticks.
Priya: guardrail behavior question: do we block saves when min exceeds pool cap or allow with confirm? My vote: allow with inline warning and a clear `Save anyway` secondary action.
Marco: agree allow+confirm. we'll emit an override audit event and the UI should surface a short rationale field optionally.
Hugo: tiny UX: when min clipped to pool max show an explanatory tooltip "Max for selected pool" rather than a raw error. less scary.
Sam: keyboard flow: Pool -> SLO -> Min -> Max -> Burst -> Save. if advanced opens, trap focus and include Escape to close. ensure color isn't the only signal on guardrail.
Anya: microcopy candidates for burst: "Temporary burst (adds capacity for selected duration)" and tooltip "Short-lived capacity; may use preemptible instances".
Priya: mobile: collapse advanced options under a chevron but show a micro summary line: "Burst: 5m  Cost: $0.12/hr" so users know at a glance.
design-bot: uploaded compact mock: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz9999/mini-capacity-flow frame names: "MiniFlow-v1", "PoolFirst-mobile".
Anya: action items: Marco to publish durations, Sam to add aria snippets, Priya to pick final microcopy, Hugo to mock the pinned cost badge animation. I'll update the figma with pool-first reorder and ping for a quick sweep tomorrow. :thumbsup:
